integrity: The simplicial complex is reconstructed from published difference cycles. All \(2^{10}\) vertex subsets and all \(\binom{10}{4}\) four-subsets are checked exactly with binary linear algebra. The earliest source date is taken from the printed date in the inspected Walkup article.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to \(M^3_2(10)\), induced vertex subcomplexes, and \(\mathbf F_2\)-homology; it does not claim an integral or all-parameter sphere-bundle classification.
title: Cyclic four-blocks characterize induced second-homology support in the ten-vertex \(S^2\times S^1\)
